text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From early morning that day, rain poured down like overturned buckets...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fuehh... It's, it's raining again...! I'm so sorry, it's all Rice's fault...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um... Rice-san is worried that the flower-viewing event being rained out is entirely her fault, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It rained last week, and the week before that too... It's because of Rice... I brought misfortune again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: That's not true at all! The event's schedule might be over, but there are still plenty of other events!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly! Let's just go next week!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No, it's okay... You two should go without me. If Rice is there, it'll just rain again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Rice-san...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Um, do you know of any place where we could view flowers even when it rains?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A greenhouse botanical garden came to mind, but sending them out into this downpour felt hesitant.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm! I wish there was a flower garden we could visit even in the rain!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I know! You two, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan? Wait, it's raining outside...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara and the others dashed out into the heavy rain. Worried about them, I decided to give chase.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is this... an aquarium? Why are we here...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Look, look! Tada, right here! It's a flower garden!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...These are jellyfish, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah, look at that poster! "Underwater Flower Garden: Illusory Jellyfish Exhibition."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: They've likened jellyfish drifting through the water to blooming flowers. How fantastical...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: It's true... The jellyfish look just like flowers blooming underwater.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: They're so, so pretty...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: See! That way, rain doesn't even matter at all~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're right... Rice was so busy being sad that I couldn't think of anything else.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan, you're amazing... You're so good at finding happiness.
choice_data_list: Happiness might just be rolling around nearby.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Positive... I see, that makes sense. I-I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You know what? Whenever you say "I'm so happy!", more and more happy things come your way~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It rained! I'm so happy! Rice-chan, try it too! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so happy...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, uh-huh! I came to the aquarium with Rice-chan and Rob Roy-chan! I'm so haaappy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so happy...! Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whether through the power of words or Haru Urara's sheer cheerfulness, a bright smile returned to Rice Shower's face.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so? Nearby... right around us, huh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That poster over there, "Hands-on Dolphin Show"...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If we all get to interact with the dolphins together, it might make for a wonderful memory...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To upbeat music, the dolphin performed an enormous jump. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Squeak squeak! Squeeeak... SPLAAASH!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Fuehh... I'm sorry. Because Rice was here, everyone got completely soaked...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: No, no, if anything, getting splashed is the best part of a dolphin show...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! That was so much fun! Let's go see the dolphins again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Indeed, Urara-san...! I'd love to go with this group again as well.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you both... so very much...!
